sql: WITH despesa_camara AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa FROM despesa_despesa WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND CAST(cod_orgao AS INTEGER) = 1 AND dsc_naturezadespesa ILIKE '3%'), receita_corrente AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND dsc_cateconomica ILIKE '%Corrente%') SELECT (CAST(d.total_despesa AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(r.total_receita AS DECIMAL), 0)) * 100 AS percentual_gasto_camara FROM despesa_camara d CROSS JOIN receita_corrente r;
